The Final dividend, if approved by the shareholders at the 31st AGM, will be paid (subject to deduction of tax at source), within 30 days from the date of approval, to the Shareholders whose names appears in the Register of Members/ Beneficial Owners on Friday, September 18, 2026. Please note that the final dividend was recommended by the Board at its meeting held on June 04, 2026.
